chats.answer:
For beginners, I recommend starting with a 10W diode laser engraver or an enclosed desktop laser engraver, depending on your budget.

The best beginner machines should be easy to set up, have reliable software, include good safety features, and work with common materials such as wood, leather, cardboard, and coated metal.

One important distinction: a 10W diode laser is excellent for learning engraving and cutting thin wood, but it generally cannot engrave bare metal directly. For that, you may need an infrared or fiber laser.

One important distinction: a diode laser is generally best for starting with wood, leather, cardboard, and some dark acrylics. If you want to engrave metal jewelry or clear acrylic, you'll need a different type of laser.
